title: Gap Inc. Taps AI to Help Keep Holiday Shopping Running Smoothly
body_markdown:
# Gap Inc. Taps AI to Help Keep Holiday Shopping Running Smoothly


by Gap Inc.


[Gap Inc.](https://www.gapinc.com/en-us/news/gap-inc)


November 25, 2026


When millions of customers head online to shop Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals, every second matters. From finding the perfect gift to checking out before a favorite item sells out, customers expect a shopping experience that is fast, reliable and easy.


Behind the scenes, Gap Inc. is putting artificial intelligence to work to help deliver that experience. The company is using Devin, an AI software engineering agent developed by San Francisco-based Cognition, to help technology teams rapidly resolve issues that can disrupt the online shopping experience.


The scale is significant. During the nine-day holiday shopping period in 2025, Gap Inc. recorded more than 75 million online shopping sessions and over 5 million online orders, processing more than 1500 orders every minute at its peak.


Behind every seamless shopping experience is a complex network of applications and services working together — from product discovery and inventory availability to shopping bags, payments and checkout. Devin’s ability to understand and work across these interconnected systems allows it to identify issues, coordinate fixes and help engineers resolve problems that span multiple applications.


Devin works alongside Gap Inc.’s other agents and software engineers through a proactive process called “site scan.” It monitors for signals of user struggle or system issues on the company’s e-commerce sites, investigates technical issues, identifies root causes and develops tested code fixes for engineers to review, validate and publish to the site.


Problems that might otherwise take days to diagnose and resolve can be addressed much faster. Across Gap Inc.’s complex global platform, Devin helps engineers quickly pinpoint issues, connect them to underlying systems and accelerate fixes that keep the shopping experience running smoothly.


Since implementing Devin, Gap Inc. estimates the company has recovered millions in sales that could have otherwise been lost to downtime.


For Gap Inc., the opportunity goes beyond solving individual problems. With Devin conducting daily checks, engineers can spend less time on repetitive troubleshooting and more time strengthening the systems customers rely on every day.


During high-traffic shopping periods like Black Friday and Cyber Monday, that added capacity can be particularly valuable. Even relatively infrequent errors can affect thousands of customers when shopping volumes are high. AI-assisted engineering helps teams shorten the time between detecting a problem and delivering a fix, supporting a smoother shopping experience when it matters most.


“Customers shouldn't have to think about the technology behind their shopping experience. They should simply be able to find what they love and check out with confidence,” said Sven Gerjets, chief technology officer at Gap Inc. “When millions of people are shopping at once, even small technical issues can have an outsized impact. We're using AI capabilities like Devin to help our engineers work faster, tackle issues more efficiently and keep our digital experiences running smoothly. It's another example of our human-centered, digitally enabled approach — using technology to make things better for people.”


Devin is designed to operate as an AI teammate, helping software engineers complete technical tasks while people remain responsible for reviewing and approving changes. Rather than replacing the expertise of Gap Inc.'s engineering teams, the technology is intended to extend their capacity, allowing engineers to delegate defined tasks and focus their attention on more complex challenges.


“Holiday shopping is a great example of why software reliability matters so much,” said Russell Kaplan, co-founder and president of Cognition. “During the busiest holiday shopping days, every second matters. Engineering teams need to move quickly to handle customer issues. Devin gives those teams an AI teammate that can take on software engineering work, investigate problems and help them get to solutions faster. We're excited to work with Gap Inc. to demonstrate how AI can improve everyday customer experiences.”


Gap Inc.'s investments in AI extend beyond the engineering systems that keep its websites operating.


Across its brands, the company is introducing conversational shopping experiences that help customers find products by describing what they're looking for in everyday language. AI-powered discovery tools on Old Navy and Banana Republic sites and apps make it easier to move from inspiration to relevant product recommendations.


Whether it's an AI shopping agent helping someone discover the right gift, a customer care assistant answering a delivery question or an AI software engineer helping resolve an issue behind the scenes, the goal is the same: remove friction and make shopping easier.
